Show the status of the most recent sync runs.

## Usage

```bash
drt status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--verbose` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Show row-level error details. |
| `--output`, `-o` | `TEXT` | `text` | Output format: text or json. |
| `--history` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Show past execution history instead of just the most recent run. |
| `--sync` | `TEXT` |  | Only show entries for this sync (--history mode only). |
| `--limit` | `INTEGER` | `20` | Max entries to show in --history mode. |
| `--check` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Judge sync freshness against alerts.on_stale and exit 1 if any sync is stale (for cron / CI). Read-only; evaluated from run history. |
| `--select` | `TEXT` |  | With --check: only these syncs (name, glob, tag:..., ...). |
| `--notify` | `BOOLEAN` |  | With --check: send an alert to each stale sync's alerts.on_stale.channels. |
| `--allow-empty` | `BOOLEAN` |  | With --check: do not fail when no selected sync configures alerts.on_stale (for rolling the watchdog out before the syncs are configured). |
